entities.summary: James Michael Scott is an American professional basketball player who last played for Gigantes de Carolina of the Puerto Rican Baloncesto Superior Nacional. He played college basketball for the Virginia Cavaliers, before being taken in the second round of the 2012 NBA draft, and spending ten seasons in the NBA.
